On top of #19705, it forces the classifier's `e2e_brain_tier` to `smoke` and adds one deliberately failing test to `neural-link/Fixture.spec.mjs`, a smoke file. Expected: the one-shard smoke run goes red through the receipt step, and merge readiness refuses the PR for it.

- **Smoke path:** [run 38332119775](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38332119775) ran one shard, `e2e-brain (1/1)`. With `TIER: smoke`, `--brain-paths` selected the eight `BRAIN_SMOKE` files, and the receipt reads `### Brain-gated e2e · smoke tier · shard 1/1` and `8 of the 97 Brain-gated spec files, with 0 of their tests quarantined`.
